description: Two passive tracers with no processes: passive_1 (zero inflow) for the identity, conservation and carry tests, passive_2 (unit inflow) for a real forecast's boundary exercise. Never a product.

rows.name: passive_1
rows.provenance: ArWen test row. floor = WRF epsilc 1.E-16 (chem/module_data_radm2.F:5; the inflow floor of bdy_chem_value_gcm, chem/module_input_chem_data.F:2349); default_inflow 0 so outflow and inflow are both exact under conservation tests.

rows.name: passive_2
rows.long_name: passive test tracer with unit inflow
rows.provenance: ArWen test row. default_inflow 1 ug kg-1 so a real forecast exercises the outer-domain inflow rule (flow_dep_bdy_chem, chem/module_input_chem_data.F:1685-2008) and the ledger's transport bucket; floor = WRF epsilc 1.E-16 (chem/module_data_radm2.F:5).

rows.name: passive_mixed
rows.long_name: passive test tracer with unit inflow and vertical mixing
rows.provenance: ArWen test row: passive_2 plus WRF-Chem's PBL-independent vertical mixing (mixing.vertmx), so a real forecast exercises a process and the ledger's process bucket; default_inflow 1 ug kg-1, floor = WRF epsilc 1.E-16 (chem/module_data_radm2.F:5).
